weapon.d: Effective against armored and cavalry foes. Grants Spd+3. If unit’s HP ≤ 75% and foe initiates combat, unit can counterattack before foe's first attack.

assist.d:
Grants another action to target ally.
(Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance.)

a.d: If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Spd/Def+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces; max 3).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Spd/Def+X to unit during combat (X = number of allies within 2 spaces + 2; max 5).
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Spd/Def+X to unit during combat (X = 2 × number of allies within 2 spaces, + 1; max 7).

b.d: If Sing or Dance is used, grants Def+3 to target.
If Sing or Dance is used, grants Def/Res+3 to target.
If Sing or Dance is used, grants Def/Res+4 to target.
